# Well Planned Journey

> > A comprehensive national park travel planning resource featuring detailed itineraries, hiking guides, and gear recommendations for America's most iconic parks including Yellowstone, Glacier, Yosemite, Zion, and more.

Created by Julia Jones and based in Atlanta, Georgia, Well Planned Journey provides trip planning guides, camping tips, and road trip itineraries to help visitors maximize their national park experiences. The site offers regularly updated guidebooks with current trail conditions and park closures.

## Key Topics

- US National Parks
- Yellowstone National Park
- Glacier National Park
- Yosemite National Park
- Zion National Park
- Joshua Tree National Park
- Redwood National Park
- Grand Teton National Park
- Trip Planning & Itineraries
- Hiking Trails
- Camping Guides
- Road Trip Planning
- Outdoor Gear Recommendations
- Park Closures & Updates
- Travel Blog
